coverage.selection: Top 10 distinct transaction senders by their largest USD-valued trade in the returned sample that was finalized at the named block. Not a holder ranking.

method.balanceMethod: ERC20 balanceOf(address) using eth_call at one fixed finalized block; decimals and chain ID cross-checked via RPC; block hash checked again after collection.
method.sampleMethod: Provider latest <=300 trades in trailing 24h; no volume threshold, no pagination, no inference that returned sample is complete.
method.senderMeaning: tx_from_address is transaction sender. Swap recipient, beneficial owner, entity labels and retained purchases have not been established.
method.usdMeaning: Provider estimated USD valuations; native amounts and raw ERC20 balances are retained separately.

routingExample.interpretation: The WETH Transfer event names the immediate token recipient, which can differ from transaction sender. Its state balances do not identify a beneficial owner or retained purchase.
